relay.asks.status.queued: Queued — the agent is continuing; expires in {duration}
relay.asks.status.queued_deadline_passed: Queued — the agent is continuing; deadline passed
relay.asks.status.late: Answered late — the agent was told
relay.asks.status.withdrawn: Withdrawn — the agent no longer needs an answer
relay.asks.status.expired: Expired — this ask is too old to answer; ask the agent again
relay.asks.status.timed_out: Timed out — the agent goes ahead without your answer
relay.asks.status.lapsed_body: the agent goes ahead without your answer
relay.asks.card.gone: this conversation no longer exists — the ask can never be read; start a new conversation and ask again.
relay.asks.card.secret_notice: secret — sent directly, not shown in the transcript
relay.asks.card.secret_notice_persisted: secret — sent directly, not shown in the transcript, and saved to your credential store
relay.asks.card.nothing_left: nothing left to answer here — another surface has already taken these questions.
relay.asks.card.cold_wait: bringing the session up — this can take up to ~30 s
relay.asks.sheet.title_waiting: asks · {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}
relay.asks.sheet.empty: nothing waiting — questions the agent asks will appear here.
relay.asks.sheet.ended_wait: this conversation has ended — answering will reopen it (this can take up to ~30 s)
relay.asks.sheet.not_running_wait: this conversation is not running — answering will bring it up (this can take up to ~30 s)
relay.asks.dock.waiting: {count, plural, one {# question waiting} other {# questions waiting}}
relay.asks.dock.timed_out: {count, plural, one {# question timed out} other {# questions timed out}}
relay.asks.error.no_reason: the daemon did not say why
relay.asks.error.read_timeout: the read timed out — the daemon is not answering
relay.asks.error.session_timeout: The session didn’t respond in time — try again.
relay.asks.error.session_gone_reopen: The terminal session went away — reopen it to answer.
relay.asks.error.session_gone_list: The session went away — reopen it from the session list.
relay.asks.error.moved_on: That question moved on — showing the current one.
relay.asks.error.already_answered_termin: Already answered — this question was settled on the terminal.
relay.asks.error.already_answered_waitin: Already answered — this question is no longer waiting.
relay.asks.gate.title: Approvals in this session
relay.asks.gate.body: Ask parks every gated tool call until you answer its card. Auto lets them run without asking for the rest of this session.
relay.asks.gate.notice_ask: keeping approvals at ask in this session
relay.asks.gate.notice_auto: this session's gate is now auto — gated tools run without asking
relay.asks.gate.not_paired_error: This phone is not paired with that machine yet — pair it once and it can give this consent itself.
relay.asks.gate.unpaired_before: This phone is not paired with that machine, so
relay.asks.gate.unpaired_middle: will ask you to pair it first. Keeping approvals at
relay.asks.gate.operator_refused: {message} (This phone's signature was refused — on that machine, `lop operator devices` shows whether this device is revoked or expired.)
relay.asks.disclosure.held_shut: Held shut while a question is waiting — answer it to reopen this panel.
